description: A tabletop card setup is in front, with a small face-up card near the top, a pile of cards and some hearts cards to the right, and a couple of loose paper cards on the left. The left hand slides over the deck at center while the right hand holds a small stack of hearts cards, then the left hand reaches up to take the face-up card and brings it down; afterward both hands gather the scattered cards into a single pile, with the left hand pushing and squaring from the left and the right hand pressing and pulling from the right until the stack is neat.
